flow: Submit invalid credentials and assert failure; submit valid credentials via real or explicitly simulated auth and assert identity/navigation state; sign out and assert cleared session. Refresh only when persistence is required.
grounding: Use actual source data and stable current anchors; new selectors only for required new UI.
Before implementation freeze one continuous browser_check covering the core causal behavior and one important edge; aim for at most 24 actions. Implementation must still satisfy the full instruction.
Use only Harness typed actions, exact expected values derived from source or test input, and end with assert_no_console_errors.
A fixture may arrange preconditions, never write the result being tested. Preserve unrelated routes and interactions.
visual_policy: Prefer deterministic DOM/state/style/geometry evidence; keep a targeted visual check only for explicit requirements those checks cannot establish.
